full_page.content:
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original message added to a Seraphic Mass Association Certificate by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
1947, February 11
Mr. Patrick H. Casey - for speedy recovery, God willing -
-perpetual member
Feast of the Apparaition of our Bl. Imaculate Mary. - Febr. 11th - 1947 God bless you Br. Pat. Offer all to Jesus - Who has suffered so much for us all - for you and me.
My Jesus - Thy will be done. Forgive us our sins.
Deliver us from the flames of Hell. Have mercy on the souls in Purgatory - Especially the most abandoned.
Don't worry Pat. Rather foster confidence in God's mercy by thanking Him for every thin - even ahead of time - Please pray for me -
Your Poor Brother - B.F. - Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.C. Sinner. -
